parameters.subject: Thank You for Your Feedback!
parameters.message:
=

Dear {{ $json[" Name"] }},

Thank you for sharing your valuable feedback about your recent trip to {{ $json["Destination"] }}.

We truly appreciate the time you took to help us improve our travel services.

Trip Summary

  • Booking Reference: {{ $json["Booking Reference"] }}
  • Traveler ID: {{ $json["Traveler ID"] }}
  • Overall Rating: {{ $json["Overall Rating"] }}/5
  • Customer Satisfaction Score: {{ $json["Customer Satisfaction Score"] }}
  • Sentiment: {{ $json["Sentiment"] }}

As a token of our appreciation, enjoy this discount code on your next booking:

TRAVEL15OFF

We look forward to planning your next adventure!

If you have any questions, feel free to contact our support team.

Regards,
Smart Tourism & Travel Planning Team
